setup.intro.value: Auspex already watches every agent session on this Mac by reading the files they write. These add explicit coordination: an MCP server for task truth and human attention, a versioned skill that teaches Supervisor/Worker/Reviewer handoffs, and hooks for states such as permission waits that transcripts do not record.

Config edits stay inside an Auspex-owned fence; the skill gets one exclusive directory with an ownership marker and content hash. Existing or modified directories are left alone. Updates are backed up to ~/.auspex/backups/ and can be undone.

trace.selectSessionDetail.value: Its prompts, tool calls, and turns appear here as they happen.

trace.showEverything.comment: Trace empty state button that clears the filter.

trace.showTab.comment: Trace filter tab tooltip. {tab} is one of trace.tab.*, lower-cased in English.

trace.spawnedBy.comment: Tooltip on the parent chip. {evidence} is how Auspex knows, in English.

trace.startFollowing.value: Scroll to the newest row as it arrives
trace.startFollowing.comment: Tooltip on the Following toggle while off.

trace.stopFollowing.value: Stop scrolling to the newest row
trace.stopFollowing.comment: Tooltip on the Following toggle while on.

trace.subagents.comment: Perch inspector: sub-agent count. distinct-from: perch.card.subagents

trace.turn.comment: Trace divider between turns. distinct-from: flight.turnCount

viewMode.board.comment: Name of the view that shows every task as a card on a wall. One of six bird-and-augury themed view names (Now, Ledger, Aviary, Flock, Perch, Flight).

viewMode.crew.comment: Name of the view that shows a wall of animated faces, one per piece of work.

viewMode.now.comment: Name of the default view (and of its sidebar row): the office stage over the lists of what needs the person now. distinct-from: catchUp.line.now

viewMode.perch.comment: Name of the view that is a user-arranged canvas of tasks, where a card stays where the person put it.

viewMode.scene.comment: Name of the view that draws the office with an animated person per agent session. Also shown upper-cased as the tag on Now's stage.

viewMode.trajectory.comment: Name of the view that opens one session out into a graph of every step it took.
